why: Line 89's condition 'a lookup ... made before any CO-A2' also covers a re-read after the confirmation turn. Its behavior 'orders cannot be checked right now; propose nothing' does not say whether the already-confirmed CO-A2 (allowed by CO-01/G-02, since an earlier lookup did answer) may still be made. CO-S10 (line 620) fails every lookup from Turn 1, so an agent or a test could go either way on that case.
